findings.title: Converted monitor config is discarded in environment context
findings.body: get_monitor_environment_context copies monitor.config into the local `config` variable and converts `config["schedule_type"]` to its display value, but the returned context uses `monitor_environment.monitor.config` instead of the converted `config`. The conversion therefore has no effect and the occurrence context continues to contain the raw schedule_type value rather than the intended display value.
